scope: Runtime normal-call integrity prerequisite with isolated tests. No installer integration, game operation, observer arming or release claimed.
status: Implemented and isolated-tested; ready for parent integration review.

api.prepare: Contract::Prepare(mainModuleBase), before entry publication, outside DllMain/locks/suspension.
api.verify: Contract::Verify(Original) while Prepared; Verify(FiveGates) after complete entry publication and thereafter.
api.roots: Contract::RootRanges(out) returns five complete original extents in StatusEntryPlan order; configured ranges are not a readiness permit.
api.failure: Permanent Fault; no reset or rebinding.

claims.Finding: The fixed retail native dispatch thunk is exactly FF E0 (JMP RAX). The runtime contract requires its complete bytes and the relocated pointer at RVA57BCA0; another CFG dispatch is rejected without replacement.
claims.Limitations: Specific pinned retail build with GUARD_CF absent; trusted Windows/CRT implementations and no unsupported external interventions remain required.

runtimeContractLimits: All 25 normal writer bodies, six IAT pointers and stable event/CV configuration must remain within the recorded contract.
Loader resolution and MEM_IMAGE protections do not prove system API authenticity or absence of inline hooks.
Arbitrary external code/data ABA, thread control, stack migration, exception callbacks and special APC intervention are outside the proof.
Router routing, trampolines, old-thread drain, observer synchronization and typed ownership receipts require separate installer integration.
